title: BombSulfurcube
description: If a cube of sulfur is filled with TNT and dropped from a height, it will explode.
body:
## BOMB SULFUR
This mod modifies the behavior of Sulfur Cubes when they are filled with TNT.
### # Mechanism: 
If a Sulfur Cube containing TNT is dropped from a height, it will detonate immediately upon impact with a solid block instead of bouncing.
